    # Use filter_pages_by_content_type to get all links categorized by type from the current page
    result = await filter_pages_by_content_type(page, page_url="/")
    # Check if 'science' category exists in the result

    science_link = None

        # If not found, return the result as-is, as per instructions
        return result
